entries.name: Ekstra Bladet via HORESTA press clips, Taco Bell åbner sin første restaurant i Danmark, 13 Oct 2026
entries.claim: Taco Bell's first Danish restaurant, Kajen Food Hall at Fisketorvet, expected to open autumn 2026; agreement signed, date not announced

entries.name: Hospitality & Catering News, Zambrero signs 14 Franchise Partners in first year of UK programme, 22 Jul 2026
entries.claim: Zambrero: more than 350 restaurants in Australia, Ireland, New Zealand, the USA and the UK; 14 UK franchise partners signed in the programme's first year; 16 UK restaurants. No Denmark.
